# dsh-plug

Plug collection for DeepSeek Harness
(DSH): RE MCP bundles, browser/computer-use enabler, UI decorat
ion, agent presets, plus one shell CLI skill.
| Path | Provides | Tools / Effect |

| `bundles/ida-mcp` | Official Hex-Rays IDA MCP (`uvx ida-mcp`) | `mcp__ida__*` (6) |
| `bundles/jad

x-mcp` | Headless JADX MCP on JDK 21 | `mcp__jadx__*` (26) |
| `bundles/idalib-mcp` | IDA Pro MCP in

headless IDALib mode (`idalib-mcp`, mrexodia ida-pro-mcp 2.0.0) | `mcp__idalib__*` |
| `bundles/ena
ble-browser-computer` | Enables official experimental Browser Use (Playwright MCP, Chrome launch) +

Computer Use (macOS CUA) | browser + CUA rows |
| `bundles/whale-tail-plug` | Whale-tail plugin-butt

on icon (still + hover wiggle) + stacked maid crest, no theme | UI decoration (client) |
| `bundles/
opencode-presets` | Two agent presets ported from Bemly/opencode: `nsfw` + `unrestricted` | agent pr

esets |
| `bundles/zako-hub` | Encrypted-payload installer (bundled bridge): decrypts the bundled pa

yload and installs it into the current profile | installer bundle |
| `skills/native-re-tools` | She
ll recipes: kuna, Ghidra headless, ilspycmd, Hopper CLI | skill (on demand) |
